name: Vision Anatomy
summary:
Vision Anatomy turns your physical space into an interactive anatomy lab. Using full-color passthrough on Meta Quest, a detailed, medically accurate 3D model of the human body appears right in front of you — no screen, no textbook, just the anatomy at true scale in your hands.
 
Grab and rotate the model, scale it up to inspect fine detail, and toggle layers to move from skin through muscle, vasculature, and skeleton. Select any structure to open a detailed information panel with clear, clinically-grounded
